children: J.Jill, Inc. reported first-quarter results for the period ended Aug 1, 2026, with revenue essentially flat at $154.8M and diluted EPS of $1.11, while net income rose to $16.8M versus $10.5M a year earlier.
Revenue was $154.8M, compared with $154M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 0.5%.
Net income was $16.8M, compared with $10.5M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 59.5%.
Diluted EPS was $1.11, compared with $0.69 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 61%.
Net sales trend: Quarter-over-quarter net sales were roughly flat (+0.5%) while year-to-date sales were down (2.7%), driven by unit declines offset by higher average unit price.

Channel mix: Retail accounted for about 53% of sales and Direct about 47%, with a modest shift toward Direct; omnichannel customers continued to spend roughly three times more than single-channel customers.
Margins and pricing: Gross margin improved to 76.8% for the quarter (72.7% YTD) due to reduced markdowns, lower promotional rates and tariff recoveries.
Operating spend: SG&A increased on higher compensation, marketing, occupancy and shipping costs as the company invests in ecommerce and inventory initiatives.
Stores and CX: Store count expanded to 255 from 247, with continued emphasis on a high-touch customer experience across stores and ecommerce.
